outcomeNote: A single amoraic qualification of the mishna's clause; no question is raised.

segments.he: וְשֶׁל מוּסָפִין כׇּל הַיּוֹם. אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: וְנִקְרָא ״פּוֹשֵׁעַ״.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «And the additional prayer» may be recited «all day. Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» Nevertheless, «one» who postpones his prayer excessively «is called negligent.»
